old: Milk is wholesome (sātmya) for all living beings, both pacifying (śamana) and purifying (śodhana), thirst-quenching and appetising (dīpanīya), and the best thing for the wasted and the injured (kṣīṇa-kṣata).
new: (Milk) is wholesome (sātmya) for all living beings, both pacifying (śamana) and purifying (śodhana), thirst-quenching and appetising (dīpanīya), and the best thing for the wasted and the injured (kṣīṇa-kṣata).
why: reviewer (minor): The subject 'milk' is not in the verse (carried over from 107-108, as the note says); it is supplied without marking.

old: The properties of the milk of each (animal), one by one and in due order, I shall describe again in full in the chapter on food and drink (annapāna).
new: The properties of the milk of each (animal), one by one and in due order, I shall describe again in full in the chapter beginning with 'annapāna' (food and drink).
why: reviewer (minor): annapāna-ādike drops ādika: the chapter is the one beginning with / named from 'annapāna', not 'on food and drink'. The Hindi keeps 'आदि'.

old: inst. pl., dvandva
new: m./n. inst. pl., dvandva
why: reviewer (minor): Gender missing: -mūlibhiḥ is the m./n. inst. pl. of -mūlin (f. would be -mūlinībhiḥ); worth stating since 119 and 138 use the f. phalinī/mūlinī.

old: n. nom. sg. ger. √jñā
new: n. nom. sg. gerundive vi-√jñā
why: reviewer (minor): 'ger.' is ambiguous (gerund vs gerundive) and the root is vi-√jñā, not √jñā.

old: वमन में अश्मन्तक को जानना चाहिए, विरेचन में स्नुही के दूध को; और अर्क का दूध विरेचन सहित वमन में प्रयोज्य समझना चाहिए।
new: वमन में अश्मन्तक को जानना चाहिए, विरेचन में स्नुही के दूध को; और अर्क का दूध विरेचन सहित वमन में जानना चाहिए।
why: reviewer (minor): 'प्रयोज्य' (to be used) is added; the Sanskrit has only vijñeyam 'to be known'. English marks the same addition with '(as used)'.

old: विरेचन में पूतीक और तिल्वक का प्रयोग करना चाहिए; कृष्णगन्धा परिसर्प, शोथ और अर्श में बताई गई है।
new: विरेचन में पूतीक और तिल्वक का प्रयोग करना चाहिए; कृष्णगन्धा परीसर्प, शोथ और अर्श में बताई गई है।
why: reviewer (minor): The printed word is parīsarpa (परीसर्प, long ī); Hindi silently normalises to परिसर्प.

old: m. nom. sg. ger. √yuj
new: m. nom. sg. gerundive pra-√yuj
why: reviewer (minor): Gerundive of pra-√yuj, not plain √yuj; 'ger.' ambiguous.

old: दद्रु, विद्रधि, गण्ड, कुष्ठ और अलजी में भी; और विवेकी वैद्य इन छह वृक्षों को शोधन करने वाला भी जाने।
new: दद्रु, विद्रधि, गण्ड, कुष्ठ और अलजी में भी; और विवेकशील व्यक्ति इन छह वृक्षों को शोधन करने वाला भी जाने।
why: reviewer (minor): 'वैद्य' is supplied without warrant in the Sanskrit (vicakṣaṇaḥ 'the discerning one'); the English marks it '(physician)', the Hindi does not.

old: f. nom. pl. ppp. √vac
new: m./f. nom. pl. ppp. √vac
why: reviewer (minor): uktāḥ is m./f. nom. pl., agreeing with a mixed-gender list (f. phalamūlinyaḥ, m. snehāḥ, n. lavaṇāni...); 'f.' alone is too narrow.

old: 3 sg. opt. √jñā
new: 3 sg. opt. vi-√jñā
why: reviewer (minor): Root is vi-√jñā (prefix omitted).

old: For a medicine not recognised by the three (marks), name, form and properties, and even one that is known but wrongly applied, leads to harm.
new: For a medicine not recognised by the three, name, form and properties, and even one that is known but wrongly applied, leads to harm.
why: reviewer (minor): '(marks)' is an added interpretation; the Sanskrit says 'by the three: name, form and properties'.

old: Indra's (Vāsava's) thunderbolt falling on the head might still leave something remaining; but a medicine prescribed by an ignorant person would not leave the patient with anything remaining.
new: Vāsava's (Indra's) thunderbolt falling on the head might still leave something remaining; but a medicine prescribed by an ignorant person would not leave the patient with anything remaining.
why: reviewer (minor): The text says Vāsava (an epithet); per LAYER_NOTES the epithet stays primary and the name is secondary.

old: m./f. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa
new: m. nom. sg., tat-puruṣa
why: reviewer (minor): nipatitaḥ (m.) agrees with it, so aśani is masculine here, not 'm./f.'.

old: but not (good) is food, drink or money taken, by one who wears the guise of the learned, from a disease-stricken person who has come to him for refuge.
new: but not (better) is food, drink or money taken, by one who wears the guise of the learned, from a disease-stricken person who has come to him for refuge.
why: reviewer (minor): The understood predicate is varam 'better' from 131 (the note says so); '(good)' changes it.

old: natu printed as one token = na tu. The predicate 'better' (varam) from unit 131 is understood: worse than those deadly acts is taking fees as a sham physician.
new: natu printed as one token = na tu. The predicate 'better' (varam) from unit 131 is understood: worse than those deadly acts is taking food, drink or wealth from a sick refugee while wearing the guise of the learned.
why: reviewer (minor): 'fees' and 'sham physician' are interpretation; the text says food, drink or wealth taken by one wearing the guise of the learned.

old: सिद्धि ही सब कर्मों के सही प्रयोग को बताती है, और सिद्धि ही सब गुणों से युक्त श्रेष्ठ वैद्य को बताती है।
new: सिद्धि सब कर्मों के सही प्रयोग को बताती है, और सिद्धि सब गुणों से युक्त श्रेष्ठ वैद्य को बताती है।
why: reviewer (error): 'ही' (emphasis) added twice; the Sanskrit has no eva here.

old: Here are the verses (summarising the chapter): the coming of Āyurveda (the science of life), the reason for its coming, its propagation, the approval of the composition (of treatises), the definition of Āyurveda,
new: Here are the verses: the coming of Āyurveda (the science of life), the reason for its coming, its propagation, the approval of the composition (of treatises), the definition of Āyurveda,
why: reviewer (minor): '(summarising the chapter)' is added; tatra ślokāḥ = 'Here (are) the verses'. Leave the explanation in notes (already there).

old: the complete (set of) causes (kāraṇa), the effect (kārya), the purpose of Āyurveda, the causes (of disease), the doṣas and, in brief, medicine,
new: the complete cause (kāraṇa), the effect (kārya), the purpose of Āyurveda, the causes (of disease), the doṣas and, in brief, medicine,
why: reviewer (minor): kāraṇam is singular; '(set of) causes' imports the six-kāraṇa interpretation that the note correctly labels as interpretation.

old: the censure of (false) physicians, and (the passage) where all the qualities of physicians are found: all this has been explained by the great sage in the first chapter.
new: the censure of physicians, and (the passage) where all the qualities of physicians are found: all this has been explained by the great sage in the first chapter.
why: reviewer (minor): '(false)' is an interpretation; vaidya-apavāda = censure of physicians (the Hindi correctly has वैद्य की निन्दा). Put the sense in notes if wanted.

old: censure of (false) physicians
new: censure of physicians
why: reviewer (minor): Same '(false)' interpretation in the gloss.

old: Thus ends the first chapter, named Dīrghañjīvitīya (On long life), in the Sūtrasthāna of the treatise composed by Agniveśa and redacted by Caraka.
new: Thus, in the Sūtrasthāna of the treatise composed by Agniveśa and redacted by Caraka, the first chapter, named Dīrghañjīvitīya (On long life).
why: reviewer (error): 'ends' is supplied (the note admits it); REVIEW_BRIEF lists 'thus ends' as a forbidden addition. The colophon is verbless.

old: इस प्रकार अग्निवेश द्वारा रचित और चरक द्वारा प्रतिसंस्कृत तन्त्र के सूत्रस्थान में दीर्घंजीवितीय नामक पहला अध्याय समाप्त हुआ।
new: इस प्रकार अग्निवेश द्वारा रचित और चरक द्वारा प्रतिसंस्कृत तन्त्र के सूत्रस्थान में दीर्घञ्जीवितीय नामक पहला अध्याय।
why: reviewer (error): 'समाप्त हुआ' is added (no verb in the Sanskrit); also the title is printed दीर्घञ्जीवितीय, not दीर्घंजीवितीय.

old: Chapter colophon. The title is taken from the chapter's opening words (dīrghaṃ jīvitam). 'ends' is supplied; the Sanskrit has no verb.
new: Chapter colophon. The title is taken from the chapter's opening words (dīrghaṃ jīvitam). The Sanskrit has no verb; the translation keeps it verbless.
why: reviewer (minor): Note should match the corrected verbless translation.
